title: Polynomial-time computation on an image
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function from binary words to binary words. Suppose a finite Boolean Turing machine $B$ has the following property: for every binary word $x$, it computes $g(x)$ from input $f(x)$ within $b(|f(x)|+1)^r$ steps, for natural numbers $b,r$. Then $g$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
for every $x$, $B$ computes $g(x)$ from $f(x)$ within the stated time bound
replaced: Let $f$ be polynomial-time computable, and let a machine compute $g(x)$ from $f(x)$ within $b\,(|f(x)|+1)^r$ steps for every input $x$, correctness being required only on the image of $f$.
